provenance.method: Loaded and answered Upscale image at fp16: one ordinary Load, then two Upscale image requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API. test night 1 Nov 2026: quiet Mac (idle check before each reading). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

peakMemoryGB.basis: Load and two Upscale image requests on a 1024×1280 photo.

provenance.method: Sum of macOS phys_footprint_peak over all Arsenal worker processes (only the measured model was loaded) across one ordinary Load, then two Upscale image requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API; MiB converted to GB (10^9 bytes). test night 1 Nov 2026: quiet Mac (idle check before each reading). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

secondsPerRequest.basis: One warm Upscale image request on a 1024×1280 photo.
